Sunset Ridge Apartments Details

Are you ready to live life to its fullest at Sunset Ridge Apartments? It’s a great place to call home if your passion is carefree, luxury living.

Our pet-friendly apartment homes feature spacious closets, individually controlled room-by-room heating, wall-to-wall carpeting, secure entries with intercom system, private balconies, air conditioning unit in the living rooms, fully applianced kitchens with dishwasher and disposal, free storage area, laundry rooms just steps from your apartment door and parking. Apartment sizes range from 633 square feet to 833 square feet. Ask about our non-smoking buildings at this location.

Our community amenities include an outdoor pool, a private clubhouse with a fireplace, cardio room, a fully applianced kitchen, and a party room. You will enjoy the manicured grounds, a dog park, picnic areas, playground and exceptional sunset views.

We are conveniently located moments to I-93 and Route 101 with easy access to Derry, Bow, Salem, and Concord. We are close to the finest in shopping, dining, and entertainment. Call today to see your new home at Sunset Ridge Apartments.  No Security Deposit is Required.

Pet Policy

Did you know we are pet friendly? We accept up to two pets in all of our apartments. We welcome your cats and small dogs! Dogs must be under 25 pounds. Breed restrictions apply.

  • ​Cats: $35 / mo (per pet)
  • Dogs: $50 / mo (per pet)
